info.name: MOTIQ API - Full Flow
info.description:
End-to-end verification collection for the MOTIQ roadside-assistance API (apps/api). Global prefix /api/v1. Run folders top to bottom: Health -> Auth -> Consent -> Customer Profile -> Provider Onboarding -> Admin Console -> Service Areas & Pricing -> Service Request Lifecycle -> Matching -> Payment -> Ratings -> SOS -> Notifications -> AI Assistant -> Data Rights -> Vehicles & Maintenance -> Provider Fleet Vehicles -> Live Tracking.

Notes:
- OTP codes are not returned by the API. In local dev, OTP delivery falls back to a server log (no Twilio configured) - check the apps/api console output and paste the code into the `otpCode` variable before running the verify request.
- There is no REST endpoint to list a provider's pending assignment offers. After creating a service request, inspect the DB (or dev logs / WebSocket tracking channel) for the generated assignment id and set the `assignmentId` variable manually before running the Matching folder.
- Admin/Support accounts are seeded out-of-band (not self-registered) - set `adminIdentifier` / `adminPassword` to a seeded admin account before running the Admin Login request.

request.description: 204 No Content on success. Check server logs for the OTP code (SMS falls back to logging when Twilio isn't configured). Throttled 5/min per IP.

First call for a new phone registers a CUSTOMER (displayName required); subsequent calls log in the same account. Extra fields beyond the DTO are rejected (whitelist validation), but role/displayName are valid DTO fields so this body works for both first-time and repeat calls.
Run '06 - Service Areas & Pricing / Create Service Area' first so {{serviceAreaId}} is populated, since PROVIDER registration requires it.
Add "totpCode" to the body if the account has MFA enrolled. Admin/Support accounts are seeded out-of-band.
Refresh tokens are single-use/rotated - the response replaces both stored tokens.
Returns { secret, otpauthUri } - load into an authenticator app, then confirm with the 6-digit code below.
Required before POST /requests will succeed for this user.
Required before PATCH /providers/me/presence with a location payload will succeed.
documentType: DRIVING_LICENSE | VEHICLE_REGISTRATION | IDENTITY_PROOF | ADDRESS_PROOF | OTHER
Requires the LOCATION_TRACKING consent grant to have succeeded first.
Set the path variable 'id' to the assigned provider's profile id (visible on the request/assignment once matched).
status: UNVERIFIED | PROVISIONAL | FULLY_VERIFIED | SUSPENDED | DELISTED. ADMIN role only. Set the 'id' path variable to the provider's profile id.
Manual stand-in for the scheduled provisional-tier expiry sweep. ADMIN only.
Ch61/Ch137's manual-dispatch queue - requests automated matching either hasn't resolved yet or gave up on. ADMIN | SUPPORT.

ADMIN only - a higher-stakes action, moves real ops flow (see MatchingService.adminOverrideDispatch()). Set providerProfileId to a verified provider's profile id in the same service area as the request.
Run this first (or 'List Service Areas' and copy an id manually) so {{serviceAreaId}} is set before Provider registration / request creation.
Must exist for the service area before a request in that area can settle payment - do this before running the Request Lifecycle folder.

issueType: TOW | REPAIR | FUEL | FLAT_TYRE | BATTERY_JUMP | OTHER. Requires LOCATION_TRACKING consent. Emits RequestCreated -> matching auto-dispatches REQUESTED -> MATCHING -> ASSIGNED. After this call, find the generated assignment id (DB/dev logs/WebSocket) and set {{assignmentId}} before running folder 08.
Also reachable by PROVIDER/ADMIN/SUPPORT tokens (customers can only view their own).
Only run this if you want to test the cancellation off-ramp instead of the full completion flow below - it transitions the request to CANCELLED_BY_CUSTOMER (terminal).

Set {{assignmentId}} manually first - there is no REST endpoint to list a provider's pending offers; offers arrive via the WebSocket tracking channel / notifications in the real app. Transitions offer to ACCEPTED and request to PROVIDER_ACCEPTED.
Use only as an alternative to Accept, not both - this sends the request back to MATCHING.
Emits RequestCompleted -> PaymentService auto-settles a Payment record for this request. Check folder 09 next.
Alternative terminal off-ramp - use instead of, not in addition to, the COMPLETED call.
Manual stand-in for the scheduled offer-expiry sweep.
The matching-ranking ML training-data export. ADMIN only.
Returns null until the request reaches COMPLETED and PaymentService auto-settles it. Also reachable by PROVIDER/ADMIN/SUPPORT tokens.

Not part of the client flow - included for completeness. The endpoint verifies the raw body against x-razorpay-signature computed with your Razorpay webhook secret; a real signature must be computed outside Postman (or via a pre-request script using the crypto-js library) for this to return 2xx.
stars: integer 1-5. Run after the request reaches COMPLETED.
Exempt from throttling and consent gating by design (safety-critical path). serviceRequestId is optional.
outcome: RESOLVED | FALSE_ALARM
platform: IOS | ANDROID
Suggestion only - does not set the request's issueType (AI is additive, never load-bearing per ADR 0007).
Throttled 20/min.
Destructive - only run this at the very end of a test pass, it erases the test customer account.
Computed-on-read per MaintenanceServiceType against MaintenanceIntervalRule - not persisted (see VehicleMaintenanceReminderLog for the separate reminder-dedup record).
Any category with no saved row yet defaults to enabled: true in the response.
Upserts every row in one call. leadTimeDays: 1-60, only meaningfully affects month-based interval rules (see vehicle-reminder.util.ts).
204 No Content. Run last in this folder - it also cascades the vehicle's maintenance records.
PROVIDER role only - a provider's own service vehicles, distinct from a Customer's Vehicle records above.
204 No Content. Run last in this folder.

Ch32/Ch54's real-driving-route (OSRM) lookup for the mobile live-tracking map - pulled by the client on its own coarse throttle, not pushed over the WebSocket gateway. A customer only sees the route for their own request; swap the Authorization header for {{providerAccessToken}} to test the provider's own-accepted-job path instead. Requires an ACCEPTED-or-later assignment to exist for {{requestId}}.
